reader_summary.overview: Charley Ellis is one of the most highly regarded experts in the investment business. After spending nearly a decade as an equity research analyst in the 1960s. Over 50 years, Charley has worked hand in hand with nearly every major financial institution in the world and has published sixteen books on investing.

key_points.text: After spending nearly a decade as an equity research analyst in the 1960s.
He extols the virtues of indexing after having looked both broadly and deeply under the covers of some of the most successful active managers in the world..
